legends-that-every-child-should-know-a-s: Editor Hamilton Wright Mabie selects the great legends of the world — King Arthur, Roland, Siegfried, and more — retold for young readers. Each tale carries the heroism and wonder that have thrilled children for centuries. A splendid introduction to the story-treasures every child deserves to know.
cytherea: Joseph Hergesheimer's novel follows a respectable middle-aged man who abandons his orderly life in pursuit of an idealized love. His quest for Cytherea — the goddess of beauty — leads him through disillusion and self-discovery. A searching, beautifully written study of desire in Jazz Age America.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-acacius-bisho: This 1913 reference article on Acacius of Beroea — the aged bishop, friend of Chrysostom. Cornelius Clifford recounts his long life. He bridged the Antiochene quarrels. A peacemaker of the early Church. He lived past a hundred, honored by all. His letters survive as models of charity.
